simple.meaning: חָכַם (châkam) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to be wise (in mind, word or act).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 28 times across Exodus, Deuteronomy, 1 Kings, Job, Psalms, and 3 more, beginning at Exodus 1:10. Its contexts include land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חָכַם (H2449).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: חָכַם (châkam) / H2449 is traced through Exodus 1:10, Deuteronomy 32:29, 1 Kings 5:11, Job 32:9 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.short: to be wise (in mind, word or act)
definitions.usage: × exceeding, teach wisdom, be (make self, shew self) wise, deal (never so) wisely, make wiser.
definitions.full: H2449. chakam חָכַם verb be wise (Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic , חֲכַם id. ; Zinjirli חכמה wisdom , DHM Sendsch.57 ; Assyrian —akâmu , know (with exceptional חֿ see Dl Pr 178 f. ); Arabic restrain from acting in an evil manner, judge, govern ; IV. make firm, sound, free from defect by the exercise of skill) — Qal Perfect ׳ח Prov 23:15 ; 3 feminine singular חָֽכְמָה Zech 9:2 ; הָכַמְתָּ Prov 9:12 (twice in verse), etc. + 3t. Perfect; Imperfect יֶחְכַּם 9:9 ; 21:11 ; וַיֶּחְכַּם 1Kin 5:11 ; יֶחְכָּ֑ם Prov 20:1 +; וֶ֯חְכָּ֑ם 13:20 ; תֶּחְכַּם 19:20 ; אֶחְכָּ֑מָה Eccl 7:23 ; plural יֶחְכָּ֑מוּ Job 32:9 ; Imperative חֲכַם Prov 27:11 ; חֲכָ֑ם 6:6 ; 23:19 + 13:20 Kt; חֲכָ֑מוּ 8:33 ; — be or become wise, act wisely Deut 32:29 (poetry) 1Kin 5:11 ; Job 32:9 ; Prov 6:6 ; 8:33 ; 9:9 , 12 (twice in verse); 13:20 ; 19:20 ; 20:1 ; 21:11 ; 23:19 ; 27:11 ; Eccl 2:15 ; 7:23 ; Zech 9:2 ; לבך חכם אם if thy mind be wise Prov 23:15 ; with accusative שׁחכמתי Eccl 2:19 wherein I have acted wisely. Pi`el Imperfect יְחַכֵּם Psa 105:22 ; suffix יְחַכְּמֵנוּ Job 35:11 ; תְּחַכְּמֵנִי Psa 119:98 ; all make wise, teach wisdom , with acc Pu`al Participle made wise , intensive, as it were the embodiment of wisdom מְחֻכָּם חֲבָרִים חוֺבֵר Psa 58:6 , plural מְחֻכָּמִים חֲכָמִים הֵמָּה Prov 30:24 (of intelligent animals). Hiph`il Participle construct מֶּ֑תִי מַחְכִּימַת Psa 19:8 making wise the simple. Hithpa`el Imperfect לוֺ נִתְחַכְּמָה Exod 1:10 (E) let us deal wisely (shrewdly) toward it (the people); 2 masculine singular תִּתְחַכַּם Eccl 7:16 make or shew thyself wise.
